WITH g AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT games_game_id, home_team_id, home_team_wins
  FROM "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."src_games"
  WHERE season = 2018
)

FROM g
JOIN "nba_analysis"."TRANSFORMED"."dim_teams_cleansed" t
  ON g.home_team_id = t.team_id
GROUP BY t.team_id, t.team_abbreviation
ORDER BY SUM(g.home_team_wins) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC, t.team_abbreviation
